notes.title: UPDATE 5.0 RELEASED
notes.notes:
[h3][b]Hello, BIGFOOT hunters![/b][/h3]

We have been working on the transition to version 5 of Unreal Engine these months. Much work has been done to adapt the project to new engine systems.

The game now supports the new Lumen global illumination system. Thanks to this, the lighting has become more realistic and pleasant. We also redesigned many objects in the game.

We can't wait to hear your feedback.  You can send us your wishes, noticed bugs, or ideas using the report form in the main menu of the game or in our Discord community.

[u][b]Please completely reinstall the game before playing! [/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=qFGFMB9BO4w;full][/previewyoutube]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/00717a97c6c405c08e2023519636e520a1b3ddba.png[/img]

[h3][b]What are the main changes in the new update?[/b][/h3]

[h3][b]EOS integration and crossplay[/b][/h3]
The game now has integration with the Epic Online Subsystem.  Since there are no dedicated servers in Bigfoot, this is the most convenient and reliable way for us to implement crossplay between Steam and EGS. Linking Steam and EGS accounts is required for online play.

With this update, the profile level in the game will be reset and in the future, we plan to add an in-game reward system to the levels.

[h3][b]New buildings[/b][/h3]

To support lumen global illumination, we had to redesign the building models.  Now they are much better quality and optimized.

[h3][b]New trees[/b][/h3]

In addition to new models and high-quality distant sprites, trees received roots that adapt to the shape and texture of the ground surface.

[h3][b]New cliffs[/b][/h3]

Not only the form but also the material was changed. Cliffs and rocks now blend better with the environment due to the ground texture projection system.

[h3][b]XBox Controller support[/b][/h3]
Implemented all interactions for XBox controller and binding settings but text input using the virtual keyboard has not yet been implemented. We are waiting for your feedback.

A more detailed list of changes is below!

notes.notes:
[h3][b]Dear friends, hello everyone![/b][/h3]

Everything is fine with us, we have temporarily moved to Bulgaria and are finally releasing the first update since the start of the war!

Your support is very valuable to us, you do not let us fall into a difficult state and your kindness gives us hope for the best. Now it's our turn to please you! By the way, you can also buy the game now with a 20% discount and skins with a 10%!

[h3][b]What are the main changes in the new update?[/b][/h3]
Adding a Yellowstone map, changing Bigfoot's attack logic, and making some AI improvements (we are waiting for their feedback). The game metrics system has also been added, it will help us to better balance the game in the future, check the performance of the mechanics, and fix problems.

notes.notes:
Hello everybody! While we are working hard on the upcoming update, which will be released this fall, we are telling you about the new things that await you in this update. This is the first part of update announcements and in it, we write about the heroes and their history, BRA in BIGFOOT. In the end, you will also find information about the key giveaway, so read to the end! 

In the new update, our heroes will decide to unite into a whole organization that will fight Bigfoot!

[b]Bigfoot Research Association (BRA)[/b] brings together the main characters of the game: Jess, Rick, Tom, and Will. Everyone has their own reason to join the team, everyone pursues their own motives, but they are united by a common goal - Bigfoot. 

Newspapers and news reports reported many missing people, with investigators finding only strangely huge tracks and a couple of scraps of unknown wool. The BRA group decided to conduct independent research and find evidence of Bigfoot's existence. Attempts have so far been in vain, and many tourists have already been found dead. They left notes, and some even kept a diary, some were found to have inhuman blood and hair, but DNA tests did not confirm anything. 

What could have really happened? BRA will come to some terrible findings... 

Also, our heroes have become more realistic and interesting. You can see their stories and models below:
[list]
[*] [b]Rick[/b]

In childhood, Rick met a strange creature. But no one believes. Neither family nor friends didn't want to accept what had happened, so many people shunned Rick and considered him insane. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/b781b79155e1fe6ea9b82f48799ca701c4d290a7.png[/img]

Rick's life turned into an eternal exploration, a search for evidence of the existence of Bigfoot himself. He became a hunter, hunted for various animals, studied flora and fauna, but didn't answer all his questions. What if he organizes a group of the same desperate hunters like him?

Every day in search of face to face with danger. And a clue.


[*] [b]Tom[/b]

Tom's life was like a drama film. Chases, shooting, detention of criminals - policeman Tom felt all this on his own skin and was infinitely proud of his work. As well as his beloved family.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/a6835d938d522690957f3d2477073c5a22ecde33.png[/img]

Somehow, together with his family, he decides to go on an extreme trip through the mountains and forests with tents. If he only knew how this journey would end... All his relatives would be killed by Bigfoot's paws, and Tom would be saved, but the feeling of revenge will flicker in his soul...

Now Tom has resigned and joined the ranks of BRA. There will be no more victims! He is confident that he will defeat Bigfoot!


[*] [b]Jess[/b]

Jess's life since school turned into a race for success. The recognition of her abilities is the highest reward that she must know full.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/fc5aae3767cc6a3c6cae0328f30c8130932098ef.png[/img]

As a recognized expert on primates, she has little work in the best science center in the country. She is confident that the Nobel Prize will go to her one day, and for this, she just needs to collect evidence of the existence of Bigfoot. How little for the worldwide recognition of her genius!

Jess arrives at the National Park with her finger on the pulse. Time is her enemy and she must have time to make the discovery of Bigfoot as a species of an animal before other researchers! And she knows that with the BRA it will be much easier for her to do it, so Jess is in business, she joins the association.


[*] [b]Will[/b]

Will has loved programming for as long as he can remember. But what a disappointment he had when the university practically did not give him the necessary knowledge, so Will began to spend a lot of time playing computer games, and after that, he even created a gamer club in his university.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/27655187/555dff6355735fa7cb361ce007fee426c474ea62.png[/img]

One day Will realized that games can not only be played, they can also be created, so he teamed up with his friends in one great goal - to make a cool game about hunting! It would be somehow boring to hunt for ordinary wondrous, but Will also adored science shows and saw many interesting animals. His interest fell on Bigfoot.

How to make a game about Bigfoot without having a lot of photos and information about him? Will decides to solve this problem and go straight to visit Bigfoot, joining the ranks of the BRA.
[/list]

That's all for now. We really want to tell you about the development and all that new that awaits you in the upcoming update, but you need to wait a bit and we will return to you with a new story, and soon with a game update!
